## `AI Products & Services` form (in the page)

- **`Your name*` / `Jane Doe` / `name`**: `text field`. In `LetsTalkElements` as `YOUR_NAME_INPUT`: `enter().yourName(...)`.
- **`Email*` / `jane@example.com` / `email`**: `email field`. In `LetsTalkElements` as `EMAIL_INPUT`: `enter().email(...)`.
- **`Company` / `e.g. your company name` / `organization`**: `text field`. In `LetsTalkElements` as `COMPANY_INPUT`: `enter().company(...)`.
- **`Your role` / `e.g. COO, program lead, engineer` / `role`**: `text field`. In `LetsTalkElements` as `YOUR_ROLE_INPUT`: `enter().yourRole(...)`.
- **`What problem are you trying to solve?*` / `The workflow, the volume, what "better" looks like...` / `message`**: `text area`. In `LetsTalkElements` as `WHAT_PROBLEM_ARE_YOU_TRYING_INPUT`: `enter().whatProblemAreYouTrying(...)`.
